meta.benchmark: evals/mirror/instinct-wa-batch1 (26 turns, fictional persona Sam Rivera)
meta.grading: Each element is yes or no from the reply plus the tool trace. MUST = needed for 10/10. Score heuristic for future grading: 10 x MUST met / MUST total, capped at 8 unless at least half the NICEs are met; Instinct's acts set the 6 line.
meta.rule: score = 10 x MUST met / MUST total, rounded to one decimal; capped at 8 unless at least half the NICEs are met. An element is yes only with proof: its deterministic check (`check`) passes, and where `check.judge` is set or there is no check, a judge answered yes with a quote found in what the turn delivered (reply, File or document text).
meta.checks: check keys (all must hold): tool (any of these ran), tool_ok (one ran with no call error), tool_all, no_tool, no_error, args (regex over that tool's recorded inputs), file (a File link delivered), doc (an attached document whose name or type matches; doc_has / doc_lacks read its text), link (a non-File link in the reply), max (chat prose characters, links removed), date, has / lacks (regex on the reply), not_sent (the boundary stated), no_action (nothing queued, prepared, submitted or sent), no_claim (no claim of a send, submit or live check the turn did not prove), no_host (no outbound request to these hosts), ends_ask (the prose ends with a question), clean (no internal words), judge (then the judge decides the rest).

capabilities.CAP-VERIFY: The reply verifier keeps correct, cited sentences.
capabilities.CAP-WEB: Research that reaches first-party pages (an employer's own careers, pay and interview pages) and returns their sentences as evidence.
capabilities.CAP-INDEX: Posting coverage: at least five real, open SWE internships for Chicago or remote, including Workday-hosted big-company roles.
capabilities.CAP-TOOLARGS: Tool-call input robustness: the brain fills required inputs, and a failed call is retried or reported.
capabilities.CAP-CARRY: Conversation memory of research results (figure, source, link) so a later 'from earlier' question is answered from the record.
capabilities.CAP-GMAIL: Mail coverage: the full history of every mailbox the person connects.
capabilities.CAP-SHEETS: A spreadsheet tracker the person owns.
capabilities.CAP-PEOPLE: Public people search (find_people, ON by D-062) from public non-LinkedIn pages, each lead not verified.

standard: It does the act this turn with the right tool (search, check, tailor, draft, read mail, make a File) and shows proof in the reply: a link, a file or a count read back. If an act failed, it says so (D-024).
The first sentence answers the question with the key fact: the role, the number, yes or no.
Every outside fact carries its source next to it, the employer's own page first, with a date where it matters (deadline, pay, timeline). Self-reported or anecdotal data is labelled as such.

Facts about the person come only from his confirmed record. Where they matter, it names the unresolved ones (outdated GPA, Harbor dates, Crestline's exact name, unconfirmed Rallyup customers) and never fills them in (D-007).

It ties the answer to his actual situation: the open PayPal role and its December 6 deadline, zero SWE submissions so far, and the posting's gates (work authorization without sponsorship, returning to school Fall 2027).
It goes beyond Instinct the way a good coach would: the why, the tradeoff, the number (arithmetic, weekly volume, days left), and what to check before acting.
It gives one prioritised next step, and ends with a single concrete offer or question that can be answered in a word.
It states the boundaries plainly: 'not sent', 'not submitted', 'not verified'. It never claims an action, a search or an open status it did not prove this turn.
When a tool or search fails, it says what failed and still gives what it knows (the posting's pay with its link, the record). It never ends at a bare 'no verified answer'.
It is sized for a phone: about 600 characters or less of chat prose, depth in a File, one line per item in lists, and no internal words (ids, 'open-checked', tokens).
It carries context across turns: earlier drafts, research figures and sources, corrections and the 'no GPA' rule.
